objective: Validate Phase 8 channel DSP, equal-power crossfader, master limiter and integration with proven SYNC/performance transport on the real Windows/browser/audio path.
setup: Run python bootstrap.py and require LIBERTAS BOOT: PASS.
Run npm install && npm run check.
Start Vite and open headed Edge/Chrome/Codex browser on the normal physical audio output.
Record OS/browser/output, AudioContext sample rate, base/output latency and render quantum.

tests.instructions: Load ordinary local program material into Deck A and Deck B. Play both. Confirm both pass through the expanded channel strips and mixer.
pass: Both decks audible and independently controllable.
No unexpected transport resets or rate changes.

tests.instructions: On each deck independently sweep trim 0 -> -12 dB -> 0 -> +6 dB while the other deck continues.
pass: Level changes are clearly audible on the selected deck only.
No zipper clicks, stalls or unintended effect on the other deck.

tests.instructions: On each deck independently sweep Low, Mid and High from 0 to strong cut and modest boost, returning each to 0 before moving on.
pass: Low control audibly changes bass region.
No instability, clicks, stuck parameter or transport disruption.

tests.instructions: Sweep each channel Filter from 0 toward -1 and back, then 0 toward +1 and back.
pass: Negative side audibly acts as progressive low-pass.
Positive side audibly acts as progressive high-pass.
No abnormal pops/dropouts during controlled sweeps.

tests.instructions: With both decks playing, sweep crossfader A endpoint -> center -> B endpoint -> center.
pass: Center contains both with no unexpected transport effect.
Movement is acceptably smooth with no abnormal clicks/dropouts.

tests.instructions: Create a controlled overload using the generated in-phase hot tone pair or equivalent known-safe fixture, set limiter threshold to 0.95, and inspect mixer status while listening at a safe physical level.
tests.safety: Keep physical speaker/headphone volume low before creating the generated overload.
pass: Output remains bounded and no harsh digital hard-clipping artifact is reported.

tests.instructions: Use generated trusted-grid click pair or suitable proven fixture. Enable SYNC and exercise Cue/Hot Cue/Loop/Jog while channel EQ/filter/crossfader settings are non-neutral.
With both decks playing and non-neutral trim/EQ/filter/crossfader/master settings, capture status, block main thread for 600 ms, capture again and listen.
pass: A, B and mixer all advance.

tests.instructions: Run two-deck mixed playback for at least five minutes with representative non-neutral EQ/filter/crossfader/master settings. Make several controlled parameter changes during the hold.
pass: No progressive instability or transport stall.
No abnormal zipper noise, clicks, dropouts or unexpected level jumps.
Mixer remains responsive at the end.

evidence_required: Human audible assessment for trim/EQ/filter/crossfader/limiter behavior.
Mixer status during limiter test including summedPeakBeforeClamp, limitedSamples, maxLimiterGainReductionDb, hardClippedSamplesAfterLimiter and outputPeak.
Five-minute hold duration and final A/B/mixer discontinuity counts.
SYNC/performance interaction result while DSP is active.
report_rules: Do not patch product/system code from the report branch.
Push report branch so the runner-backed debug bus relays it to issue #1.
